name: predicate_true
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0 WHERE c1 > 0

name: predicate_false
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0 WHERE NOT(c1 > 0)

name: predicate_unknown
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0 WHERE CASE WHEN (c1 > 0) THEN 0 WHEN NOT(c1 > 0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1

name: compound_unknown
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0 WHERE CASE WHEN (c1 > 0 OR c0 > 0) THEN 0 WHEN NOT(c1 > 0 OR c0 > 0) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END = 1

name: norec
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c1 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM t0

name: typed_nullif
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0 WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(c0,c0),0)=0

name: empty_count
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t2 WHERE c0 > 0

name: empty_norec
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c0 > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM t2

name: left_join_rows
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0 LEFT JOIN t1 ON t0.c0=t1.c0

name: left_join_unmatched
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t0 LEFT JOIN t1 ON t0.c0=t1.c0 WHERE t1.c0 IS NULL

name: left_join_norec
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.c0 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) FROM t0 LEFT JOIN t1 ON t0.c0=t1.c0
